title: fix: mobile UI improvements — menu, panel toggles, toolbar, scalebar, TimeUI
body: ## Purpose - Reorganize the mobile interface for MMGIS to improve usability: move hamburger menu items to a top-right kebab menu, show account/login and panel togglers, make toolbar layout driven by `isMobile` flag instead of CSS breakpoints, position scalebar/compass same as desktop, and add a functional mobile TimeUI toggle. ## Proposed Changes - [CHANGE] Removed left-side hamburger menu, moved BottomBar items (Copy Link, Screenshot, Settings, Info, Help) into a kebab dropdown in `#topBarRight` - [CHANGE] Panel toggle buttons (Viewer/Map/Globe) and login UI now visible in `#topBarRight` on mobile - [CHANGE] Toolbar horizontal layout driven by `isMobile` flag (CSS in `UserInterfaceMobile_.css`) instead of `@media` breakpoints - [CHANGE] Scalebar always renders full desktop version (removed simplified mobile branch) - [CHANGE] Removed `display: none` on `.leaflet-control-scalefactor` on mobile - [ADD] Mobile toolbar: 40px height, 40px button width, no border-bottom, flush `bottomFloatingBar` (no border-radius, left/right/bottom = 0) - [ADD] `#topBar` padding-left: 34px, `#splitscreens` top: 40px on mobile - [ADD] `BottomElementPositioner` pushes scalebar/compass/map scale up by 40px (toolbar height) on mobile - [ADD] Hidden "Keyboard Shortcuts" from kebab menu on mobile - [FIX] `TimeUI.init()` isMobile detection — replaced 16 `L_.UserInterface_?.isMobile` checks with `_getUIStore().getState().isMobile` (lazy accessor avoids circular import; Zustand store is populated before TimeUI.init runs, while L_.UserInterface_ is null) - [ADD] Mobile `#timeUI` staged in hidden `#timeUIMobileStaging` container, with `MobileTimeUIToggle` toolbar button that moves it into/out of `#tools` - [FIX] Auto-rescues `#timeUI` back to staging when another tool opens (prevents DOM destruction) - [FIX] Skipped desktop `#timeUI` reparenting observer on mobile - [CHANGE] Hidden TimeUI toggle from settings modal on mobile (toolbar button handles it) - [FIX] Unified toolbar/bottomFloatingBar transition timing (0.3s ease-out) ## Issues - N/A ## Testing - CI passing: test (local), test (off), secret-detection, generate-tags, bump-version all green - Docker build failures (build-arm64, build-amd64) are pre-existing and unrelated Link to Devin session: https://nasa-jpl-demo.devinenterprise.com/sessions/c4073373404c4605ad444c87e7bdf7fe Requested by: @tariqksoliman ---
